title: A Spider Lived 43 Years, the Oldest Ever Recorded

scenes.text: Scientists watched one spider for 42 years.
She was a trapdoor spider in Western Australia, first spotted as a spiderling in 1974.
Researchers checked her burrow every six months. They thought these spiders lived about 25 years.
She reached 43, the oldest spider ever recorded. The old record was a 28-year-old tarantula.
She never left her burrow, ambushing prey from behind a hidden lid.
In 2016, a parasitic wasp likely pierced her lid. Her name was just Number 16.

description:
Scientists watched one spider for 42 years.
A trapdoor spider nicknamed Number 16 lived to about 43, the longest-lived spider ever recorded. She stayed in her burrow her entire life.
How long would you wait to find out? Tell us below.
first_comment: Researchers expected trapdoor spiders to live about 25 years. Number 16 nearly doubled that. What's the oldest pet you ever had?
